title: Guarantee, urgency and misrepresentation in one call

lines.t: Good morning, this is Neha calling from Suraksha Life Insurance. Am I speaking with Mr Rao?
Yes, speaking. Who is this again?
Neha from Suraksha Life. You had asked for a call back about our plans on our website.
Oh yes, I did. Go ahead.
Before we discuss anything, may I confirm your date of birth for verification?
It is the fourteenth of August, nineteen eighty six.
Thank you, that matches our records.
Based on that, I would suggest our Suraksha ULIP. Part of your premium buys life cover and the rest is invested in funds you choose.
How much would I need to pay?
For five lakh of cover, around fifty thousand rupees a year for ten years.
This is assured return of ten percent, fully guaranteed.
And can I take the money out if I need it?
Yes, it works exactly like a savings account, there is no lock-in.
Sir, the scheme closes today, decide now or you will regret it.
Thank you for your time. You will receive the documents by email today.
